notes: Loaded from the existing Phase 6 artifact; it was not retrained or reselected on the test split.
Test metrics were computed once, after the threshold was frozen.
The threshold was chosen on validation predictions and frozen before the test partition was evaluated.
ROC-AUC ranks across all thresholds; the threshold above is a separate operating point, not the AUC.

generalisation.note: Train metrics are in-sample; they are reported only as an overfitting signal, never as performance evidence.

notes: Folds are drawn from train+validation rows only; the test partition is not used.
Each fold refits the Phase 5 column plan, imputers, scaler and encoder on its own training rows; validation rows are transform-only.
Fold metrics use the 0.5 reference threshold, not the validation-selected operating threshold.
Class weights are the Phase 5 training weights in every fold, matching the weights used for the final family fits.
The MLP is refitted from scratch in every fold with an internal training-only hold-out for early stopping.

selection.rationale: Selected Random Forest because it had the highest validation f1 (0.7985) at its validation-selected operating threshold. MLP Neural Network followed with 0.6937. The MLP was not the best model on the validation criterion; the benchmark does not assume it must win. The test partition was not used to choose the model.
notes: Selection uses validation predictions only, after thresholds were frozen.
Accuracy alone is not the selection criterion; the configured metric is f1.

error_analysis.interpretation: A false positive is a retained customer predicted to churn (wasted retention spend). A false negative is a churner predicted to stay (missed save opportunity). Recall drives missed churners; precision drives outreach cost.

logistic_regression.note: Aggregate counts and mean probabilities only; no customer identifiers or raw records are exposed.

random_forest.note: Aggregate counts and mean probabilities only; no customer identifiers or raw records are exposed.

mlp.note: Aggregate counts and mean probabilities only; no customer identifiers or raw records are exposed.

preprocessing.strategy: refit per fold from the Phase 5 base frame

notes: CV metrics are a stability estimate at the 0.5 reference threshold; the held-out test result remains the primary evidence.
Each fold refits the Phase 5 column plan, imputers, scaler and encoder on its own training rows; validation rows are transform-only.
The base frame is reconstructed from the recorded raw artifact and accepted only if a full-training refit reproduces the Phase 5 matrices exactly; otherwise CV is reported as unavailable.

limitations: Metrics describe one held-out split; they are not a guarantee of future churn behaviour or causal retention impact.
A threshold selected to maximise validation F1 is a statistical choice, not automatically the best business decision; contact costs and capacity are modeled in later phases.
The benchmark compares model families on one dataset; results do not transfer automatically to other customer bases.
Test metrics were computed once. Re-running this benchmark on a new split produces a new evaluation, not a re-tuned score for this one.
Cross-validation refits preprocessing inside every fold, but the fold split is a single seeded 5-fold partition; it does not quantify split-to-split variance.
Probability calibration is summarised by the Brier score only; no recalibration was fitted.
